usageCycleLocal: Extrapolated from locally priced usage and account quota consumed, using reference API prices. Other devices may be missing.
usageCycleIncomplete: History is incomplete; this estimate is indicative.
copyFailedSelectAndCopyTheTextManually: Copy failed. Select and copy the text manually.
usageStale: Last successful reading; may be out of date.
usagePinUnavailable: Pinned window is unavailable; showing the default pool.
usageAccountBlocked: The source reports an account restriction.
usagePoolBlocked: The source reports a restriction on this pool/window.
usageRequestFailed: Usage could not be read. Retrying automatically.
usageCredentialDenied: Access to the current login was denied or timed out.
usageNoLimits: The source did not report readable limits.
usageRateLimited: The source requested a pause before retrying.
usageNetworkError: Unable to reach the subscription service.
usageInvalidResponse: The subscription response could not be interpreted.
usageUnsupported: This source is not supported on this platform.
insights.requestsHelp: Model requests with observed responses; cumulative increments from legacy logs are not counted as requests.
insights.estimatedCostHelp: API-equivalent estimate using reference prices, cached input and service tier. This is not subscription billing or credits consumed; records without prices are excluded.
insights.cacheHitHelp: Cached input tokens divided by all input tokens.
insights.title: Title
insights.restoringHelp: Showing the last complete overview while local logs are indexed. Totals and the selected period reflect the time below; task details become available when indexing finishes.
insights.speedHelp: Total output tokens ÷ total duration of measured turns, including tools and waiting; not pure model generation speed. Overview samples turns fully contained in the selected period; task metrics cover the task's lifetime. Missing output or positive duration is shown as —.
insights.tierHelp: Scheduling setting recorded for this turn, not a confirmed server execution tier. Missing settings are not inferred.
insights.quotaHelp: Account quota from the native sign-in, across devices. It cannot be allocated as charges to local tasks.
insights.usageHelp: Readable logs on this device, grouped by event time in the host device’s local time. Cached tokens are part of input; reasoning tokens are part of output.
insights.modelHelp: Requested model configuration in the log, not a confirmed execution model.
insights.taskHelp: Tasks are ordered by latest update, 10 per page by default (5, 10, 20, 50 or 100 selectable). Search covers all indexed tasks. Child tasks are counted separately.
insights.turnHelp: Newest turns first. Duration includes tools and waiting; average output is not generation speed. Status reflects the last log event.
insights.responseHelp: Modern responses take precedence and are deduplicated by identity. Legacy deltas and compaction references are not added again.
insights.toolHelp: Tools are linked by call ID. A return does not establish success; bytes are not tokens.
insights.bindingHelp: Only a local task identity supplied by the host is linked automatically. Select local records manually for cloud, other-device or unidentified tasks; selection affects this panel only.
insights.sourceHelp: Covers readable sessions and archived_sessions on this device. Cloud, other-device and account attribution coverage is unknown. Cost and credits are unavailable.
insights.tokenHelp: Cache is a subset of input; reasoning is a subset of output. Missing or conflicting fields show —. A known subtotal is not a complete total.
insights.cachedHelp: Included in input; not added to the total again.
insights.reasoningHelp: Included in output; not added to the total again.
insights.relationsHelp: Tasks are counted separately. Unproven parent/child boundaries are not merged; compaction references are not counted again.
insights.freshHelp: Visible panels refresh every 10 seconds. Refresh reads data without creating a model turn.
insights.recordHelp: This record has conflicting or invalid fields and is not treated as a reliable total.
insights.fallbackIssue: Some record coverage is unknown. Check the source.
insights.timeout: The host timed out. Please retry.
insights.schemaError: The plugin and local service formats are incompatible. Update and reopen.
insights.issue.legacy-coverage-response-: Legacy logs do not establish response or compaction coverage.
insights.issue.legacy-related-history-pa: Related legacy histories include only confirmed new usage.
insights.issue.legacy-inherited-baseline: The inherited baseline is missing; related usage is excluded.
insights.issue.legacy-overlap-baseline-c: Overlapping legacy counters conflict; related totals are unknown.
insights.issue.legacy-counter-reset-gap: A cumulative counter reset leaves usage across the boundary unknown.
insights.issue.legacy-prefix-excluded-fr: A legacy prefix is excluded from modern response totals; early coverage is incomplete.
insights.issue.foreign-thread-record-exc: Inherited records belonging to other threads are excluded.
insights.issue.partial-tail-pending: The final log line is still being written.
insights.issue.conflicting-response-usag: The same response has conflicting values; affected totals are unknown.
insights.issue.invalid-or-missing-token-: Some token fields are missing or have inconsistent subset values.
insights.issue.oversized-line-not-indexe: Some log lines exceed the read limit; coverage is incomplete.
insights.issue.response-sum-cumulative-m: Observed responses differ from the native cumulative total; history coverage needs review.
insights.issue.compaction-response-not-o: A response referenced by compaction has not been observed.
insights.issue.source-rewritten-history-: The source was rewritten and reindexed; removed history is unknown.
insights.issue.legacy-missing-cumulative: A legacy record has no cumulative baseline; its increment is unknown.
insights.issue.missing-session-identity: Some logs have no native task identity.
insights.issue.missing-response-id: Some modern records have no response identity and are excluded from totals.
insights.issue.missing-turn-id: Some usage records cannot be linked to a turn.
insights.issue.missing-event-time: Records without event timestamps are excluded from period totals.
insights.issue.invalid-json-line: An invalid log line was skipped.
insights.issue.file-unreadable: Some files are unreadable; the previous snapshot is retained.
insights.issue.file-read-failed: Reading was interrupted and will retry on the next scan.
insights.issue.file-discovery-limit: The file discovery limit was reached; coverage is incomplete.
insights.issue.file-metadata-unavailable: Metadata is unavailable for some files.
insights.issue.file-seek-failed: Reading could not resume at the saved file position.
insights.issue.checkpoint-unavailable: The checkpoint could not be saved; logs will be reread after restart.
insights.guide.open.title: Open overview and task usage
insights.guide.open.body: Open Usage overview from the host explorer or sidebar. In a task, choose New tab → More tools → Task usage, or select a task in the overview. The panels read Codex logs without making a model call.
insights.guide.empty.title: No tasks or usage yet
insights.guide.empty.body: Usage reads this computer’s current user’s local Codex logs. Complete a local turn in a signed-in Codex client, then refresh; existing logs do not require a new task. Other Agents are not automatically included in these token statistics. Cloud and other-device tasks without local logs do not appear. Clear filters if needed; the task list defaults to 10 items per page with an adjustable page size and searches all indexed tasks.
insights.guide.binding.title: Select the intended task
insights.guide.binding.body: If the host provides no valid task identity, use Select task beside the title. Choose the local task you intend to inspect; the panel never substitutes the latest task. If a cloud task cannot open a local panel, select a local task from the overview. Its data does not describe the cloud task.
insights.guide.quota.title: Missing or stale account quota
insights.guide.quota.body: Quota is read through the installed native Codex CLI using its current login. Check sign-in in the native client if unavailable. Quota and log statistics are independent; unavailable quota does not mean full remaining allowance.
insights.guide.entrypoints.title: Plugin, desktop app and remote access
insights.guide.entrypoints.body: This plugin provides Usage overview and Task usage in ChatGPT Desktop. It reuses a compatible host runtime. A separate Node installation, Rust and Connector Desktop are not needed. It does not expose a network service.
insights.guide.data.title: Coverage and counting
insights.guide.data.body: Only readable local Codex logs are counted, not the account’s full activity. Cached input and reasoning output are subsets and are not added twice. Missing fields show —; a confirmed subtotal may be incomplete. Parent and child tasks are counted separately. Tool return sizes and whole-turn durations are not charges or pure generation speed. Charts filter event time; daily groups use the host device’s local time.
insights.guide.lifecycle.title: What happens when you close it
insights.guide.lifecycle.body: Hidden panels pause refreshing. The host manages the plugin process. Closing or reloading the plugin stops its own collectors; it does not control Agent tasks.
insights.guide.permissions.title: Access and task operations
insights.guide.permissions.body: Usage panels are read-only. The plugin also provides local project reads, file operations and Agent controls, to be used for your explicit requests. External Agents retain their own sign-in and permissions; remote ingresses authenticate separately. Removing the plugin does not automatically delete projects, original logs or external Agents.
insights.guide.connection.title: Connection failure or prolonged loading
insights.guide.connection.body: Retry first. If it persists, check that Usage is enabled in the host, close and reopen the panel, or restart the host when work can safely be interrupted. If both development and installed variants are present, enable only the one you intend to use. Retry also reconnects after failed host initialization.
insights.guide.version.title: Version mismatch
insights.guide.version.body: Update the usage plugin through its Git marketplace and reload the host. This plugin does not share a backend or require a matching Connector Desktop version.
insights.guide.update.title: Still seeing the old UI after an update
insights.guide.update.body: Run codex plugin marketplace upgrade chatgpt-usage, then reload the plugin and reopen its panels. Existing processes keep their previous version until reloaded.
insights.guide.remove.title: Uninstall and retained data
insights.guide.remove.body: Remove usage@chatgpt-usage in the host. Codex logs and accounts are untouched. The plugin retains its own disposable usage cache.
insights.contextUnavailable: The log does not include a complete context observation or window capacity.
insights.toolContextUnknown: Returned bytes are not context tokens. Changes are observed in subsequent requests and cannot be attributed to this tool alone.
insights.recordScope: Local usage record; full request bodies and tool inputs/outputs are not included.
insights.compactionObservation: Values are input observations from adjacent requests and may include new content, rather than exact compaction sizes.
